notes.title: March 24 2023 Game Update release notes(Ver.1.0.1873 patch information)
notes.content:
DEMO version
・The number of stages available for trial play of the DEMO version has been expanded to Stage 7.

Full version

Stages
・The number of flower fields and the number of enemies are now indicated on the stage selection screen.
・In the stage selection screen, the "Tutorial Stage" markers have been added to Stage 1 and Stage 6.
・Stage 1 has been modified as a beginner tutorial stage.
・Stage 6 has been modified as an advanced tutorial stage.
・The order of stages 17 and 20 was swapped in consideration of the difficulty level.
・The order of stages 22 and 23 was swapped in consideration of the difficulty level.
・The position of the flower garden in stage 43 has been fine-tuned.

Bee units
・The characteristics and features of bees are now displayed in the information window for each type of bee.
・The outlines of the bees have been highlighted to make it easier to distinguish between the different types.
・When multiple bees are selected and the queen bee is included, a warning message is displayed in the information window alerting restriction of actions when the queen is included.

Enemy Icons
・The position of enemy icons has been adjusted to improve the playing environment.
・When multiple enemy icons overlap, moving the mouse cursor to the location of the overlapping icons will now swap the enemy icons up and down.
・Enemy icons in battle now relay battle messages.
・The number indicating the distance to the queen bee on the enemy icon now changes according to the distance.
・Enemy icons that are overlapping the mouse are now larger.

General System
・The honey storage will no longer disappear when the amount of honey in the honey storage becomes zero.
・The scrolling function at the edge of the screen has been adjusted to have a narrower range of detection.
・The position of the "Return to Game" menu item during the game has been moved to the top of the screen.
・The range of the worker bee training has been widened.
・A bar for adjusting the emphasis of the outlines of the bees has been added to the options.
・Added 16x speed to game progression speed change.

Battle
・When many bees are attacked by an enemy, they now attack in a dispersed manner.
・The detection distance for automatic attacks when an enemy approaches the hive has been adjusted to be wider.
・If worker bees are in the process of growing when an enemy approaches the hive, they will return the honey they are carrying to the storage and join the attack.
・If a bee attacks when the enemy approaches the hive, the surrounding bees will also join the attack.
・As the enemy approaches the queen, the priority of the enemy attack is changed to the enemy closest to the queen.
・When an enemy is found while returning to the nest after a battle with the enemy, it will attack automatically.

UI
・The mini-map is now colored according to the type of bee and the enemy.
・The minimap no longer expands when the mouse cursor is moved over it.
・The total number of bees and the total amount of honey are now displayed.
・The "Delete Storage" button is now displayed when a deletable storage is selected.

Graphics
・Scrolling at the edge of the screen in windowed mode has been eliminated.
・Various language modifications have been made to reflect the changes made in this update.

Bug fixes
・Fixed a bug in which enemies did not disappear when their health reached 0.
・Fixed a bug that the enemy's health did not decrease.
・Fixed a bug that enemies did not return after eating larvae.
・Fixed a bug in which the bees would not attack when they found an enemy while returning to the hive after a battle.
・Fixed a bug in which worker bees would not finish building up.
・Fixed a bug that caused the command panel to not respond when the action panel was pressed.

notes.title: Update before the Winter Sale! (Ver. 1.0.1812 patch information)
notes.content:
Thank you for playing BeeCraft.
We are pleased to announce the release of version 1.0.1812
STEAM is now available to the public.
We are continuing to add features and develop the game to make it even more enjoyable.
Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Trial version released
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Bee Craft.
We have prepared a demo version so you can try the game for free.
And for the full challenging "Bee RTS" experience, consider checking out the full version.

We hope you enjoy playing BeeCraft!

notes.title: Hello and more to all of you!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Bee Craft!
We would like to announce that we have decided to change the price of the game to reach a broader audience.
In order to make the game more accessible, we have reduced the price to $9.99.
If you have never played BeeCraft before, take this opportunity to try it out.
It is a rare game that can be enjoyed by both beginners and experts of the RTS genre, and we are confident that you will find a good challenge in it!
We will continue to develop Bee Craft to add more features and make it more fun. 
Thank you for your support!
